_note: Week 8 example, written for the raw (pre-schedule-adjustment) tiers. Copy the structure only: rewrite every reason from a fresh facts.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

cover.label: Week 8 NFL Team Tiers · ranked by net EPA/play, not record
cover.line1: The 6-1 Bills and 6-1 Vikings aren't top-5 teams.

slides.hook: Five teams winning on both sides of the ball.

why.JAX: Best pass offense (+0.27 EPA/dropback) and #1 run defense. Crushed IND 42-7.
why.SF: #1 offense, best success rate (53%). Pass defense is 18th, the one soft spot.
why.KC: #4 offense, #3 run game. Lost 28-24 at DEN, but the numbers still say top 3.
why.LAR: #3 defense, #3 vs. the pass. A 4-4 record, but the numbers say top 5.
why.CIN: #2 success rate (50%), #4 pass offense. 23rd-ranked run defense. Won 43-36 in OT.

slides.hook: The 6-1 Bills and Vikings land here. Each is elite on only one side.

why.BUF: #2 offense, #1 run game. Defense is the leak: 23rd, and 24th vs. the pass.
why.CHI: Top 12 in pass and run offense, #4 defensive success rate. Won 34-17 at SEA.
why.GB: #7 defense (-0.07). Pass offense is +0.13, but the run game ranks last (-0.24).
why.MIN: #1 defense (-0.17 EPA allowed), but the 29th-ranked offense. Lost 19-15 at DET.
why.TB: #2 defense (-0.16), #6 run game, 31st pass offense. Shut out ATL 16-0.
why.NE: #8 offense, #7 pass offense (+0.16). 21st-ranked pass defense. Beat MIA 24-19.
why.PIT: #2 run game (+0.12), #3 run defense. Four straight wins, 27-6 over CLE.

slides.hook: Ten teams within 0.07 EPA per play of each other.

why.NYJ: Offense #11, pass defense #25. Lost 38-33 to LV.

slides.hook: 5-3 Cleveland is stuck here: 25th in net EPA per play.

why.ATL: 28th offense (-0.09), 29th in the air. Shut out 16-0 at TB. Defense ranks 10th.
why.LV: #6 pass offense (+0.18), but the 31st run game and 28th defense. Won 38-33 at NYJ.
why.CLE: 5-3 flatters them: 25th net EPA, 25th offense. Lost 27-6 at PIT.
why.ARI: 31st pass defense (+0.22 allowed), 5th vs. the run. Won 33-30 in OT at DAL.
why.NO: 31st run defense, 31st defensive success rate. Offense ranks 22nd.

slides.hook: The 0-7 Chargers aren't last. The 2-6 Eagles are.

why.TEN: 26th offense, 25th defense, 28th pass D. Lost 43-36 in OT at CIN.
why.MIA: Worst defense in the league (+0.13), worst pass D (+0.30). Lost 24-19 to NE.
why.IND: 30th offense (-0.12), 30th pass offense (-0.22). Beaten 42-7 at JAX.
why.LAC: Worst offense in the league (-0.26), last in pass offense. Defense is 9th.
why.PHI: Worst net EPA: 31st offense, 29th defense, last vs. the run. Six straight losses.

slides.hook: Steelers jump 7 spots. Seahawks and Ravens each fall 6.

why.PIT: Up 7, the biggest jump. Four straight wins, #2 run game. Beat CLE 27-6.
why.CHI: Up 4. Won 34-17 at SEA. Top 12 in pass and run offense.
why.TB: Up 4. The #2 defense shut out ATL 16-0. Pass offense is 31st.
why.SEA: Down 6, the biggest drop. Lost 34-17 to CHI. 24th-ranked offense.
why.BAL: Down 6 after losing 36-10 at BUF. Three straight losses.
why.CAR: Down 5 after losing 27-19 at GB. 28th-ranked run defense.

slides.also: Also up: TB +4, WAS +3, TEN +3. Also down: CAR -5, CLE -4, MIN -3, DEN -3, IND -3.
